BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Graham, Ley, Volz, Marshall, Dufault, and Eslick

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Postsecondary Education & Workforce.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the use of state appropriated funds by institutions of higher education to repair property damaged in a disruptive activity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the use of state appropriated funds by institutions of higher education to repair property damaged in a demonstration, riot, or other disruptive activity; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A public institution of higher education that allows any demonstration, riot, or other activity that disrupts the normal educational process, and which causes destruction of property at the institution is prohibited from spending any state appropriated funds or funds received from tuition and fees to repair the damage.
